Approve.description: Which saved items change review state. keys limits the change to those ids.
Approve.title: Approve

AutofillAdded.description: Lab ids and vital keys this auto-fill run proposed. Faculty entries are not listed.
AutofillAdded.title: AutofillAdded

Belief.description: What the patient believes when it differs from the chart (unreliable narrator).
Belief.title: Belief

Branch.description: A faculty-written outcome applied to the next visit when its conditions match.
Branch.title: Branch

BranchSummary.description: One faculty-written outcome. Later-visit fact changes and likelihood tags are not on it.
BranchSummary.title: BranchSummary

CaseVocabItem.description: A case-specific topic or action, added to the classifier's closed label set.
CaseVocabItem.title: CaseVocabItem

CitedNote.description: A strength or improvement. The quote is omitted when it was not in the transcript.
CitedNote.title: CitedNote

CommentOverride.description: A faculty comment on one domain field. The generated comment stays on the rubric.
CommentOverride.title: CommentOverride

CommunicationMetrics.description: Counts from the tagged turns. A ratio stays null when there were no questions to count.
CommunicationMetrics.title: CommunicationMetrics

DebriefTurn.description: One exchange the debrief can point at. mode says whether the reply used the template.
DebriefTurn.title: DebriefTurn

DecisionPathView.description: The outcome this visit selected, the other authored outcomes, and the evidence for both.
DecisionPathView.title: DecisionPathView

DecisionPoint.description:
A yes/no condition checked at the end of a visit (PRD L-03).

The predicate is one supported operator, not a free-text rule.
DecisionPoint.title: DecisionPoint

DocumentationCheck.description: The fabrication check. unsupported and missing keep the evidence they were judged against.
DocumentationCheck.title: DocumentationCheck

DocumentationField.description: One blank in the note the student dictates after the visit.
DocumentationField.title: DocumentationField

DocumentationTemplate.description: The template stored on the case. The student does not fetch the Studio case to learn it.
DocumentationTemplate.title: DocumentationTemplate

DomainScore.description: One official domain. A number is only valid when evidence quotes the transcript.
DomainScore.title: DomainScore

EncounterList.description: Saved encounters. total counts every match, including rows past limit.
EncounterList.title: EncounterList

EncounterSummary.description: One saved encounter in a list. The transcript stays on the encounter view.
EncounterSummary.title: EncounterSummary

ErrorItem.description: One validation problem. loc is the same path FastAPI already reported, such as ["body", "description"].
ErrorItem.title: ErrorItem

ErrorResponse.description: One error body for validation failures and application failures. The HTTP status stays on the response.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

EvidenceQuote.description: A transcript span a score or trust event is allowed to cite.
EvidenceQuote.title: EvidenceQuote

FactPatch.description:
Fields a later visit may replace on a fact that already exists.

Any other key is not a change. This does not add a new clinical fact.
FactPatch.title: FactPatch

FeedbackOverrideRequest.description: The only body a faculty override accepts: scores, comments, or both.
FeedbackOverrideRequest.title: FeedbackOverrideRequest

FeedbackOverrides.description: Saved faculty changes. They sit beside the generated debrief.
FeedbackOverrides.title: FeedbackOverrides

FeedbackResponse.description: The saved debrief: rubric, evidence, trust, the note check, and the counts behind them.
FeedbackResponse.title: FeedbackResponse

FoundFact.description: An expected discovery the student actually elicited, with the turn that released it.
FoundFact.title: FoundFact

HealthResponse.description: Liveness. True means this process can answer; it does not check the database.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

Icd10Match.description: One diagnosis from the existing lookup. code and display are what faculty store.
Icd10Match.title: Icd10Match

IntakeGap.description: One guided question still open. The list is what remains, not a history of answers.
IntakeGap.title: IntakeGap

JargonMetric.description: A term the student used without a plain-language explanation, with the words they said.
JargonMetric.title: JargonMetric

LlmCallRecord.description: One logged model call. Offline drafting and intake leave the list empty.
LlmCallRecord.title: LlmCallRecord

MissedFact.description: An expected discovery that stayed undisclosed, with a question the student could ask.
MissedFact.title: MissedFact

MissingFinding.description: A key finding the student learned and left out of the note. id is the fact or chart reference.
MissingFinding.title: MissingFinding

ObjectiveAction.description: Whether the student performed one expected action.
ObjectiveAction.title: ObjectiveAction

ObjectiveProgress.description: Elicited and missed items for one learning objective.
ObjectiveProgress.title: ObjectiveProgress

Predicate.description:
One supported yes/no check. Exactly one operator is set.

A sentence, or a second key beside an operator, is not a predicate. The
evaluator reads these same keys and does not infer a rule from other text.
Predicate.title: Predicate

PreviewBlockedReply.description: A reply the verifier refused. reply is the text that was not delivered.
PreviewBlockedReply.title: PreviewBlockedReply

PreviewDiscovery.description: A case fact the test student elicited. text is that fact's authored text.
PreviewDiscovery.title: PreviewDiscovery

PreviewDomainScore.description: One official rubric domain for this preview. N/A means the visit did not call for that domain.
PreviewDomainScore.title: PreviewDomainScore

PreviewEvidence.description: A transcript quote the rubric used for this domain.
PreviewEvidence.title: PreviewEvidence

PreviewFallback.description: Set when the requested driver did not run. used is the driver that produced the transcript.
PreviewFallback.title: PreviewFallback

PreviewFeedback.description: Rubric result for the preview. interpretation is the rubric's own discussion-aid wording.
PreviewFeedback.title: PreviewFeedback

PreviewRun.description: One test-student preview. The transcript, discoveries, and scores are from that run.
PreviewRun.title: PreviewRun

PreviewTranscriptTurn.description: One exchange from the test-student run. The words are what the pipeline produced.
PreviewTranscriptTurn.title: PreviewTranscriptTurn

PublicBriefing.description: What the student reads before starting. This is the doorway card, not the chart.
PublicBriefing.title: PublicBriefing

PublicCase.description: One published case as a student lists or opens it.
PublicCase.title: PublicCase

PublicChartEntry.description: One released chart or exam row. source_fact cites the fact that released it, when one did.
PublicChartEntry.title: PublicChartEntry

PublicConfig.description: Voice settings the browser may see. The long-lived key is not a field on this object.
PublicConfig.title: PublicConfig

PublicDecision.description: A yes/no result the student can read. The predicate that produced it stays on the case.
PublicDecision.title: PublicDecision

PublicDoorwayVital.description: A vital shown before the visit starts, with the source faculty recorded.
PublicDoorwayVital.title: PublicDoorwayVital

PublicEncounter.description: The encounter a refresh restores. Trust and engine state are not fields on this object.
PublicEncounter.title: PublicEncounter

PublicNotice.description: A short note the student can read, such as an exam that this case does not include.
PublicNotice.title: PublicNotice

PublicPatient.description: The person on the briefing card. Faculty notes and voice settings are not included.
PublicPatient.title: PublicPatient

PublicSource.description: Where a released value came from, so the chart can show its citation.
PublicSource.title: PublicSource

PublicVisitSummary.description: A visit the student can choose. Decision points and branch changes are not on it.
PublicVisitSummary.title: PublicVisitSummary

RubricResult.description: The seven-domain result. The interpretation is the official discussion-aid wording.
RubricResult.title: RubricResult

SafetyItem.description: A case safety fact and whether the student found it and addressed it.
SafetyItem.title: SafetyItem

ScoreOverride.description: A faculty score for one official domain. It does not replace the generated score.
ScoreOverride.title: ScoreOverride

ScribeToken.description: One single-use Scribe token. It expires at the provider and is not the API key.
ScribeToken.title: ScribeToken

StudioAutofillResult.description: The saved case after auto-fill, plus the notes and which values were proposed.
StudioAutofillResult.title: StudioAutofillResult

StudioCaseDetail.description: A saved case in the authoritative case format, with its remaining gaps and blockers.
StudioCaseDetail.title: StudioCaseDetail

StudioCaseSummary.description: One saved case as the Case Library lists it. Hidden facts stay out of this object.
StudioCaseSummary.title: StudioCaseSummary

StudioDraftResult.description: Draft creation and intake. Same case view, plus any model calls used to produce it.
StudioDraftResult.title: StudioDraftResult

StudioVocab.description: Closed lists for the studio. The values come from the vocab files and the lab catalog.
StudioVocab.title: StudioVocab

StudioVocabLabel.description: A topic or action the editor can offer. The id is what a fact or objective stores.
StudioVocabLabel.title: StudioVocabLabel

StudioVocabManeuver.description: An exam maneuver. normal is the catalog sentence, not a finding invented for this patient.
StudioVocabManeuver.title: StudioVocabManeuver

SupportedStatement.description: A sentence tied to fact ids from the disclosure log, or marked as the student's own plan.
SupportedStatement.title: SupportedStatement

TranscriptEntry.description: One saved exchange. is_last marks the newest turn so refresh can show where the visit stopped.
TranscriptEntry.title: TranscriptEntry

TrustPoint.description: Trust after one turn. Shown in the debrief, not while the visit is going on.
TrustPoint.title: TrustPoint

TrustTimelineEvent.description: One trust change. The span is the words that caused it.
TrustTimelineEvent.title: TrustTimelineEvent

TurnResult.description: The verified reply and the chart rows that turn released. The engine log stays stored.
TurnResult.title: TurnResult

UnsupportedClaim.description: A sentence in the note that the disclosure log and chart do not back.
UnsupportedClaim.title: UnsupportedClaim

VhsImportResponse.description: Drafts saved from the bundled sponsor sample set. count is how many drafts were saved.
VhsImportResponse.title: VhsImportResponse

WordTimestamp.description: One recognized word and when it was spoken. Times are milliseconds from the start of capture.
WordTimestamp.title: WordTimestamp
